## Capacity Development Activities

- 5 in-country missions (COM, KEN, MDG, OMN, TZA)
- 3 technical workshops (PS, PS, GN)
- Virtual technical meetings
- External meetings (UE, FAO)

---

## Data Management Activities

- Improved [guidelines for reporting fisheries statistics](https://data.iotc.org/reference/guidelines/stats/index.html)
- Developed [guidelines for Regional Observer Scheme (ROS) data](https://data.iotc.org/reference/guidelines/ros/index.html)
- [IOTC Reference Data Catalogue](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/index.html)
- Reporting forms GitHub repository [`iotc-data-forms`](https://github.com/iotc-secretariat/iotc-data-forms)
- Revised [form descriptions](https://data.iotc.org/reference/form-descriptions/index.html)

  - Updated [Form 7PR](https://data.iotc.org/reference/form-descriptions/stats/Form-7PR.html)
  - Proposed extended [Form 1RC](https://data.iotc.org/reference/form-descriptions/stats/Form-1RC.html)
